articles.title_en: Affirmative Action and Precollege Human Capital
articles.title_cn: 平权行动与大学前人力资本
articles.abstract_en: Though racial affirmative action (AA) policies are widespread in college admissions, evidence on their effects before college is limited. We study a US Supreme Court ruling that reinstated AA in three states. Using nationwide SAT data, we separately identify positive effects of AA for Whites and underrepresented minorities. Using Texas administrative data, we find that AA narrowed racial gaps in grades, attendance, and college applications. Improvements in minorities’ precollege human capital and college applications are concentrated in the top half of the test score distribution among the students for whom the policy most increases the returns to human capital investment. (JEL H75, I21, I23, I28, J15, J24, K10)
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管种族平权行动（AA）政策在大学招生中广泛存在，但关于其在大学前影响的证据有限。我们研究了一项美国最高法院裁决，该裁决在三个州恢复了平权行动。利用全国性的SAT数据，我们分别识别出平权行动对白人和代表性不足少数族裔的积极影响。利用德克萨斯州的行政数据，我们发现平权行动缩小了成绩、出勤率和大学申请方面的种族差距。少数族裔大学前人力资本和大学申请的改善集中在考试成绩分布的上半部分，即政策最提高人力资本投资回报的学生群体中。（JEL H75, I21, I23, I28, J15, J24, K10）

articles.title_en: The Unintended Consequences of Test-Based Remediation
articles.title_cn: 基于测试的补习教育的意外后果
articles.abstract_en: School systems around the world use achievement tests to assign students to schools, classes, and instructional resources, including remediation. Using a regression discontinuity design, we study a Florida policy that places middle school students who score below a proficiency cutoff into remedial classes. Students scoring below the cutoff receive more educational resources, but they are also placed in classes that are more segregated by race, socioeconomic status, and prior achievement. Increased tracking occurs not only in the remedial subject, but in other core subjects. These tracking effects are significantly larger and more likely to persist beyond the year of remediation for Black students. (JEL H75, I21, I28, J15)
articles.abstract_cn: 世界各地的学校系统使用成绩测试将学生分配到学校、班级和教学资源，包括补习。利用断点回归设计，我们研究了佛罗里达州的一项政策，该政策将分数低于熟练度截止分数的初中生安排到补习班。分数低于截止分数的学生获得更多教育资源，但他们也被安排在按种族、社会经济地位和先前成绩更加隔离的班级中。增加的追踪不仅发生在补习科目中，也发生在其他核心科目中。这些追踪效应对于黑人学生来说显著更大，并且更有可能在补习年份之后持续存在。(JEL H75, I21, I28, J15)

articles.title_en: Reversing the Resource Curse: Foreign Corruption Regulation and the Local Economic Benefits of Resource Extraction
articles.title_cn: 逆转资源诅咒：外国反腐败监管与资源开采的本地经济收益
articles.abstract_en: We examine how foreign corruption regulation affects the economic benefits communities receive from extraction activities in the resource-rich areas of Africa. After a mid-2000s increase in enforcement of the US Foreign Corrupt Practices Act (FCPA), nighttime luminosity increases by 15 percent (5 percent) in communities within a 10-kilometer (25-kilometer) radius of affected extraction facilities. Cash-wage employment also increases significantly, suggesting that the economic benefits are not limited to electricity access. Consistent with foreign corruption regulation mitigating the political resource curse, we find that perceived corruption decreases following the rise in FCPA enforcement. (JEL D73, F23, K22, L14, O13, O17, Q31)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了外国反腐败监管如何影响非洲资源丰富地区社区从开采活动中获得的经济收益。在2000年代中期美国《反海外腐败法》（FCPA）执法力度加强后，受影响的开采设施周围10公里（25公里）半径内的社区夜间灯光亮度增加了15%%（5%%）。现金工资就业也显著增加，表明经济收益不仅限于电力供应。与外国反腐败监管缓解政治资源诅咒相一致，我们发现FCPA执法力度上升后，感知腐败有所下降。（JEL D73, F23, K22, L14, O13, O17, Q31）

articles.title_en: The Impact of Youth Medicaid Eligibility on Adult Incarceration
articles.title_cn: 青年医疗补助资格对成年监禁的影响
articles.abstract_en: This paper identifies an important spillover associated with public health insurance: reduced incarceration. In 1990, Congress passed legislation that increased Medicaid eligibility for individuals born after September 30, 1983. We show that Black children born just after the cutoff are 5 percent less likely to be incarcerated by age 28, driven primarily by a decrease in incarcerations connected to financially motivated offenses. Children of other races, who experienced almost no gain in Medicaid coverage as a result of the policy, demonstrate no such decline. We find that reduced incarceration in adulthood substantially offsets the initial costs of expanding eligibility. (JEL H51, I13, I18, I38, J15, K42)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文识别了公共医疗保险的一个重要溢出效应：减少监禁。1990年，国会通过立法，提高了对1983年九月30日之后出生的个人的医疗补助资格。我们表明，恰好在该截止日期之后出生的黑人儿童在28岁时被监禁的可能性降低5%，这主要是由于与财务动机犯罪相关的监禁减少。其他种族的儿童，由于该政策几乎没有获得医疗补助覆盖，没有表现出这种下降。我们发现，成年期监禁的减少在很大程度上抵消了扩大资格的最初成本。(JEL H51, I13, I18, I38, J15, K42)

articles.title_en: Does Exposure to Other Ethnic Regions Promote National Integration? Evidence from Nigeria
articles.title_cn: 接触其他民族地区是否促进国家融合？来自尼日利亚的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines how temporary exposure to a different ethnic region affects national integration, using original survey data from participants in Africa’s largest national youth service program. Seven years later, participants randomly assigned to serve in a state with a different ethnic majority are five times more likely to live all across the country compared to those who served in their ethnic region. They have more interethnic romantic relationships and express greater national pride. Nevertheless, immersion in a different region strengthens participants’ ethnic pride and favorable attitudes toward co-ethnics. The results suggest that national and ethnic identity can thrive together. (JEL D12, D91, J13, J15, O15)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文利用非洲最大国家青年服务项目参与者的原始调查数据，考察了临时接触不同民族地区如何影响国家融合。七年后，被随机分配到不同民族占多数的州服务的参与者，与在其民族地区服务的参与者相比，在全国各地居住的可能性高出五倍。他们拥有更多的跨族裔浪漫关系，并表现出更强的民族自豪感。然而，沉浸在不同地区增强了参与者的民族自豪感和对同族人的好感。结果表明，国家认同和民族认同可以共同发展。（JEL D12, D91, J13, J15, O15）

articles.title_en: At What Level Should One Cluster Standard Errors in Paired and Small-Strata Experiments?
articles.title_cn: 在配对和小分层实验中，标准误应在哪一层进行聚类？
articles.abstract_en: In matched pairs experiments in which one cluster per pair of clusters is assigned to treatment, to estimate treatment effects, researchers often regress their outcome on a treatment indicator and pair fixed effects, clustering standard errors at the unit-of-randomization level. We show that even if the treatment has no effect, a 5 percent–level t-test based on this regression will wrongly conclude that the treatment has an effect up to 16.5 percent of the time. To fix this problem, researchers should instead cluster standard errors at the pair level. Using simulations, we show that similar results apply to clustered experiments with small strata. (JEL C21, C90, G21, O16, O18)
articles.abstract_cn: 在匹配配对实验中，每对聚类中有一个聚类被分配到处理组，为了估计处理效应，研究者通常将其结果对处理指示变量和配对固定效应进行回归，并在随机化单位层面对标准误进行聚类。我们表明，即使处理没有效应，基于该回归的5%水平的t检验也会错误地得出处理有效应的结论，错误率高达16.5%。为解决此问题，研究者应改为在配对层面聚类标准误。通过模拟，我们表明类似结果适用于具有小分层的聚类实验。（JEL C21, C90, G21, O16, O18）

articles.title_en: Informed Enforcement: Lessons from Pollution Monitoring in China
articles.title_cn: 知情执法：来自中国污染监测的启示
articles.abstract_en: Government regulations are often imperfectly enforced by public officials. In this study, we exploit the introduction of air pollution monitors in China to investigate whether real-time monitoring of policy outcomes affects the enforcement of existing regulations. Using assignment criteria established by the central government and new georeferenced data on local enforcement activities, we show that monitoring (i) increases enforcement against local firms, (ii) improves the targeting of enforcement, and (iii) reduces aggregate pollution. These effects are driven by officials facing performance incentives and are stronger when there is limited scope for data manipulation, suggesting that real-time monitoring improves top-down accountability. (JEL K32, L51, O13, P25, P28, Q52, Q53)
articles.abstract_cn: 政府法规往往被公职人员执行得不完美。在本研究中，我们利用中国引入空气污染监测器的契机，考察政策结果的实时监测是否影响现有法规的执行。利用中央政府设定的分配标准和关于地方执法活动的新地理参考数据，我们表明监测（i）增加了对当地企业的执法，（ii）改善了执法的针对性，并且（iii）减少了总体污染。这些效应由面临绩效激励的官员驱动，并且在数据操纵空间有限时更强，这表明实时监测改善了自上而下的问责制。（JEL K32, L51, O13, P25, P28, Q52, Q53）

articles.title_en: The Marginal Returns to Distance Education: Evidence from Mexico’s Telesecundarias
articles.title_cn: 远程教育的边际回报：来自墨西哥电视中学的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper analyzes a large-scale and long-running distance education program in Mexico. We estimate marginal treatment effects (MTEs) for learning in math and Spanish in telesecundarias relative to traditional Mexican secondary schools using an empirical framework that allows for unobserved sorting on gains. The estimated MTEs reveal that school choice is not random and that the average student experiences significant improvements in both math and Spanish after just one year of attendance in telesecundarias. We find that the existing policy reduces educational inequality, and our policy-relevant treatment effects show that expanding telesecundarias would yield significant improvements in academic performance. (JEL I21, I24, I26, I28, O15)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文分析了墨西哥一个大规模、长期运行的远程教育项目。我们使用一个允许基于收益的不可观测选择的实证框架，估计了电视中学相对于传统墨西哥中学在数学和西班牙语学习上的边际处理效应（MTEs）。估计的MTEs揭示，学校选择并非随机，且平均学生在电视中学就读一年后，数学和西班牙语均有显著提高。我们发现，现有政策减少了教育不平等，而我们的政策相关处理效应表明，扩大电视中学将带来学业表现的显著提升。（JEL I21, I24, I26, I28, O15）

articles.title_en: Is It Who You Are or What You Get? Comparing the Impacts of Loans and Grants for Microenterprise Development
articles.title_cn: 是身份还是所得？比较贷款与赠款对微型企业发展的影响
articles.abstract_en: Is the type of financial support provided to businesses more important than which businesses receive it? Loans and grants can lead to differences in optimal investments and in scope for moral hazard. We randomize 3,293 business loan applicants into receiving a loan, cash grant, in-kind grant, or nothing. All treatments equally increase income, yet there are large differences within a treatment group with impacts concentrated at the top of the distribution. Those who succeed with loans are observationally equivalent to those who succeed with grants, showcasing that owner heterogeneity is more important than the type of support received in microenterprise development. (JEL D22, D82, G32, H81, J16, M13, O16)
articles.abstract_cn: 提供给企业的金融支持类型是否比哪些企业获得支持更重要？贷款和赠款可能导致最优投资和道德风险范围的差异。我们将3,293名企业贷款申请者随机分配为获得贷款、现金赠款、实物赠款或什么都不给。所有处理组同样增加了收入，但处理组内部存在巨大差异，影响集中在分布顶端。贷款成功者与赠款成功者在观察上等同，表明在微型企业发展中，所有者异质性比所获支持类型更重要。(JEL D22, D82, G32, H81, J16, M13, O16)

articles.title_en: Gender Attitudes in the Judiciary: Evidence from US Circuit Courts
articles.title_cn: 司法系统中的性别态度：来自美国巡回法院的证据
articles.abstract_en: Do gender attitudes influence interactions with female judges in US circuit courts? In this paper, we propose a judge-specific measure of gender attitudes based on use of gender-stereotyped language in the judge’s authored opinions. Exploiting quasi-random assignment of judges to cases and conditioning on judges’ characteristics, we validate the measure showing that higher-slant judges vote more conservatively in gender-related cases. Higher-slant judges interact differently with female colleagues: they are more likely to reverse lower court decisions if the lower court judge is a woman than a man, are less likely to assign opinions to female judges, and cite fewer female-authored opinions. (JEL D91, J16, K41)
articles.abstract_cn: 性别态度是否会影响美国巡回法院中与女法官的互动？在本文中，我们基于法官撰写的意见中使用性别刻板语言的情况，提出了一种针对法官个体的性别态度衡量方法。利用法官对案件的准随机分配并控制法官特征，我们验证了该衡量方法，显示倾向性更高的法官在性别相关案件中投票更为保守。倾向性更高的法官与女性同事的互动方式不同：如果下级法院法官是女性而非男性，他们更可能推翻下级法院的判决，更不可能将意见分配给女法官，并且引用的女性撰写的意见更少。(JEL D91, J16, K41)

articles.abstract_en: This paper explores the extent to which workers are willing to trade hours worked for leisure time shared with their spouse. We use the fact that the number and timing of paid vacation days to which French employees are entitled vary in a quasi-random way from year to year along with the dates of public holidays. Self-employed workers do not benefit from public holidays, but we show that a large fraction of them substitute a day of unpaid leisure for a day of paid work whenever their spouse gets an extra day of paid leave. (JEL D12, D91, J22, J23)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了工人愿意用工作时间换取与配偶共享休闲时间的程度。我们利用法国雇员有权享受的带薪休假天数和时间以及公共假日日期在年度间准随机变化的事实。自雇工人不享受公共假日，但我们表明，当他们的配偶获得额外一天的带薪休假时，他们中的很大一部分人会用一天的无薪休闲替代一天的有薪工作。（JEL D12, D91, J22, J23）

articles.title_en: Increasing the Cost of Informal Employment: Evidence from Mexico
articles.title_cn: 提高非正规就业的成本：来自墨西哥的证据
articles.abstract_en: We estimate the effect of increasing the cost of informal jobs on formal firms’ and workers’ outcomes. We combine administrative records and household surveys and exploit exogenous variation in the cost of informality generated by over 480,000 random worksite inspections in Mexico. For informal workers, inspections temporarily increase the probability of being formalized at the inspected firm, but separations also rise. For formal workers, we find temporary increases in the probability of remaining formally employed at the inspected firm and in monthly wages. At the firm level, increasing the cost of informal jobs leads to persistently lower formal employment. (JEL D22, E26, J22, J31, J46, O15)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们估计了提高非正规工作成本对正规企业和工人结果的影响。我们结合行政记录和家庭调查，并利用墨西哥超过480,000次随机工作场所检查所产生的非正规性成本的外生变化。对于非正规工人，检查暂时增加了在被检查企业被正规化的概率，但离职率也上升了。对于正规工人，我们发现留在被检查企业正规就业的概率和月工资暂时增加。在企业层面，提高非正规工作的成本导致正规就业持续下降。（JEL D22, E26, J22, J31, J46, O15）

articles.title_en: What Impacts Can We Expect from School Spending Policy? Evidence from Evaluations in the United States
articles.title_cn: 学校支出政策能带来哪些预期影响？来自美国评估的证据
articles.abstract_en: We conduct meta-analysis on a comprehensive set of studies of the impacts of US K-12 public school spending on student outcomes–estimating average marginal impacts and heterogeneity across contexts. On average, a policy increasing spending by $1,000 per pupil for four years improves test scores by 0.0316σ and college-going by 2.8 pp. Moving beyond averages, we use estimates of heterogeneity and observable policy differences to produce informative probability distributions of policy effects. Effects are smaller for economically advantaged populations, marginal effects of capital spending are similar to noncapital, and effects are similar across baseline spending levels and geography. Confounding and publication biases are minimal.(JEL H75, I21, I22, I26, I28)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们对美国K-12公立学校支出对学生成果影响的一系列综合研究进行了元分析，估计了平均边际影响及不同背景下的异质性。平均而言，一项政策每名学生增加1,000美元支出并持续四年，可使测试分数提高0.0316个标准差，大学入学率提高2.8个百分点。超越平均值，我们利用异质性估计和可观察的政策差异来生成政策效应的信息性概率分布。对经济优势人群的影响较小，资本支出的边际效应与非资本支出相似，且效应在基线支出水平和地理区域间相似。混杂偏倚和发表偏倚最小。(JEL H75, I21, I22, I26, I28)

articles.title_en: Employer Concentration and Wages for Specialized Workers
articles.title_cn: 雇主集中度与专业工人工资
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies how wages respond to a sudden change in employer concentration by using the deregulation of the Swedish pharmacy industry. The reform involved a substantial and policy-driven increase in the number of employers that varied by local labor market. Exploiting this variation, elasticities of wages with respect to labor market concentration are estimated between −0.025 and −0.061. The positive wage effects from reduced employer con centration are most prevalent for more mobile workers as well as younger and foreign-born workers. Overall, the paper finds that employer concentration matters for wages in a context where skills are industry specific. (JEL J24, J31, J42, L13, L81, L88)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文利用瑞典制药行业的放松管制，研究了工资如何应对雇主集中度的突然变化。该改革涉及雇主数量的实质性且由政策驱动的增加，且因地方劳动力市场而异。利用这一变化，估计工资对劳动力市场集中度的弹性介于−0.025和−0.061之间。雇主集中度降低带来的正向工资效应在流动性更强的工人以及年轻和外国出生的工人中最为显著。总体而言，本文发现，在技能具有行业特定性的背景下，雇主集中度对工资具有重要影响。(JEL J24, J31, J42, L13, L81, L88)

articles.title_en: The Virus of Fear: The Political Impact of Ebola in the United States
articles.title_cn: 恐惧的病毒：埃博拉在美国的政治影响
articles.abstract_en: We study how public anxiety over the threat of a disease outbreak can affect voter behavior by looking at the Ebola scare that hit the United States in 2014. Exploiting timing and locations of the four cases diagnosed in the country, we show that heightened concern about Ebola led to a lower Democratic vote share and lower turn-out, despite no evidence of a general anti-incumbent effect (including President Obama). Voters displayed increasingly conservative attitudes on immigration, but not on other ideologically charged issues. Our findings indicate that emotional reactions can have a strong electoral impact, mediated by issues plausibly associated with the specific triggering factor. (JEL D72, D91, I12, J15)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过研究2014年袭击美国的埃博拉恐慌，探讨公众对疾病爆发威胁的焦虑如何影响选民行为。利用该国确诊的四例病例的时间和地点，我们发现对埃博拉担忧的加剧导致民主党得票率下降和投票率降低，尽管没有证据表明存在普遍的反在位者效应（包括奥巴马总统）。选民在移民问题上表现出日益保守的态度，但在其他意识形态色彩浓厚的问题上并非如此。我们的研究结果表明，情绪反应可以产生强烈的选举影响，并通过与特定触发因素合理相关的问题进行中介。（JEL D72, D91, I12, J15）
